title: Rob Runett (Motley Fool Ventures Partner) on the STATION DC fireside — 'the next destination should be mission primacy'
summary: Runett is a partner at Motley Fool Ventures. He published his notes from the STATION DC conversation, including Eric's view that profit should be redefined as the maximization of human flourishing and that mission autonomy matters more than valuation.
blockquote: Ries said the era of shareholder primacy is over, and we've moved into an era of extraction primacy. The next destination should be mission primacy.
